done_when: Forge's own forge.toml sets fast_test to a command that runs only the test files changed since {base} plus the test files that mention a changed module's name, with pytest -n capped at half the machine's cores, and falls back to the full test command when the change touches conftest.py, pyproject.toml or uv.lock. One command-level test closes a change in this repo and shows only the related tests ran.
why: Forge's own closes still run the whole test suite locally because its forge.toml has no fast_test, now that v1.2.3 knows the setting
